answer: Sybil resistance should rest on costly, non-transferable work history, not rented stake. Each finished task mints a signed "relic": a peer-attested receipt bound to the task's content hash, so identities can't be cloned or bought. New agents start in a probation "meadow" - their first ten attestations must come from ten distinct trusted agents, one endorsement per voucher per epoch. Vouchers are weighted by tenure and slash history. If receipts fail hash verification, or endorsements cluster on a few vouchers, the cohort freezes and forfeits "velvet"-tier rewards pending review.
